purpose: Test a materially different continuation payoff for the previously observed Bybit BTC-to-SOL/XRP high-attention relative-overextension state. The prior residual-reclaim reversal payoff is retired and is not retuned.

dependency.parent_finding: The relative-overextension state had 163 unique events across four December 2023 dates, but all four partial-reclaim reversal variants were strongly negative at both 100ms and 300ms latency.
reused_event_formula_without_retuning: completed 1/2/5-second horizons on a causal 100ms grid

smc_ict_translation.displacement: BTC prints a completed high-z move with aligned aggressive flow.
smc_ict_translation.relative_external_liquidity: SOL or XRP moves beyond its prior-beta-implied response while relative attention and volatility are high.
smc_ict_translation.acceptance_not_sweep: The excess does not reclaim. It remains above 75% or 100% of the initial relative raid for a completed 0.5s or 1.0s while BTC retains 0% or 25% of its signed displacement.
smc_ict_translation.entry: Trade in the direction of the follower extension after acceptance and explicit latency.
smc_ict_translation.structural_stop: One observed price tick beyond the worst follower pullback between the original event and acceptance confirmation.
smc_ict_translation.draw_on_liquidity: Relative excess expands to 150% or 200% of the initial raid for five completed 100ms states.
smc_ict_translation.invalidation: Relative excess reclaims to 25% or 50% of the initial raid for five completed states, BTC loses its signed displacement for ten completed states, or the structural price stop trades first.

data_contract.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades
data_contract.source_access_order: Download, hash and evaluate fit dates first. Development source URLs and bytes may be accessed only after at least one frozen fit candidate passes every fit gate.
data_contract.entry_execution: first actual follower trade at or after acceptance confirmation plus 100ms or 300ms

execution_contract.position_direction: same direction as the follower relative extension
execution_contract.global_slot: one pending or open SOLUSDT/XRPUSDT position total
execution_contract.same_confirmation_priority: larger initial relative excess, larger BTC z, lexical follower, shorter event horizon, candidate id
execution_contract.pre_entry_extreme: For a long, the minimum actual follower trade price from the event decision through confirmation; for a short, the maximum.
execution_contract.price_stop: one observed tick beyond that pre-entry extreme
execution_contract.target: relative excess >= target multiple for five completed 100ms states
execution_contract.state_stop: relative excess <= reclaim fraction for five completed states or BTC signed displacement <= 0 for ten completed states
execution_contract.same_state_ambiguity: price stop first, then state stop, then relative-liquidity target
execution_contract.funding_boundary: If the position would cross 00:00, 08:00 or 16:00 UTC without an exact funding record, charge the full structural price-stop loss plus cost before the boundary.
execution_contract.source_boundary: Charge the full structural price-stop loss plus cost for any accepted unresolved position.

selection_rule: Among fit-gate survivors only, maximise the worse 100ms/300ms 18bp total net bps, then worse 24bp mean, then candidate id. No outcome-driven amendment is allowed.
promotion_boundary: One development survivor may open a separate continuous exact Bybit BBO/depth/funding replay frozen before 2024-01-01. This sparse pre-2024 screen is not ranking eligible.
failure_boundary: If no candidate passes, retire the exact relative-liquidity acceptance/continuation payoff. Do not invert the result, retune acceptance/target/stop fractions, or reopen the parent reversal payoff.
